SELECT T.PRD_DESIGN_ID id, T.PRD_DESIGN_SERIAL_NAME text FROM PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO T
AND T.DATA_STATUS = #{dataStatus}
AND (T.PRD_DESIGN_ID LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')) OR T.PRD_DESIGN_SERIAL_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%')))
ORDER BY T.PRD_DESIGN_ID ASC

SELECT T.*, T2.PRD_DESIGN_SERIAL_NAME finProductName, t3.item_value riskLevelStr, t4.item_value ajustRiskLevelStr, t2.PRD_DESIGN_ID prdDesignId FROM PRD_RISK_LEVEL T left join PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO T2 on T.FIN_PRODUCT_CODE = T2.PRD_DESIGN_ID left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST t3 on t.RISK_LEVEL = t3.item_code and t3.dict_code = 'RISKLEVEL' left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST t4 on t.AJUST_RISK_LEVEL = t4.item_code and t4.dict_code = 'RISKLEVEL' where T.IS_LAST=#{isLast} AND t.branch=#{branch}
AND T2.PRD_DESIGN_ID = #{finProductName} /*产品名称*/
AND T2.PRD_DESIGN_ID = #{prdDesignId} /*产品设计编号*/
AND T.GENERATE_TIME >= to_date(#{startDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') /*开始日期*/
AND to_date(#{endDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= T.GENERATE_TIME /*结束日期*/
ORDER BY T.SEQ_NO ASC
SELECT T.*,T2.PRD_DESIGN_SERIAL_NAME finProductName FROM PRD_RISK_LEVEL T inner join PRODUCT_DESIGN_INFO T2 on T.FIN_PRODUCT_CODE = T2.PRD_DESIGN_ID WHERE T.SEQ_NO = #{pk} ORDER BY T.SEQ_NO ASC
